messages.subject: bernoulli_logit
parts:
Hi all,

Is there any change about bernoulli_logit function. Before I can use this normally without any problem but after updating to the latest release of rstan 2.14.2, I run the same model (nothing change) but I got the following error:

Exception thrown at line 183: bernoulli_logit_log: n is -2147483648, but must be in the interval [0, 1]

and line 183 is:

   for (i in 1 : N){
ik4d[i] ~ bernoulli_logit(be4d[1] * age[i] + be4d[2] * gender[i] + be4d[3] * In_CM[i] + be4d[4] * In_DC[i]
+ be4d[5] * In_NC[i] + be4d[6] * In_OT[i] + be4d[7] * In_PS[i]
   + (be4d[8] + be4d[9] * age[i] + be4d[10] * gender[i] + be4d[11] * In_CM[i] + be4d[12] * In_DC[i]
+ be4d[13] * In_NC[i] + be4d[14] * In_OT[i] + be4d[15] * In_PS[i]) * year[i]
   + be4d[16] * alone[i] + be4d[17] + b0ik4d[ID[i]]);
}

The only thing I did is updating rstan.

Do you have any idea?

Thanks,
Tran.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: bernoulli_logit
parts:
On Saturday, April 15, 2017 at 11:37:17 AM UTC-4, Tran wrote:
Exception thrown at line 183: bernoulli_logit_log: n is -2147483648, but must be in the interval [0, 1]
That means some ik4d[i] is declared but not defined as a 0 or 1.
